Method of Attack: Backdoor used in initial stages of attack to establish persistence on target machine
Controlled via proxy network to hide location of command and control (C2) server
Discoverer: Symantec DeepSight Managed Adversary and Threat Intelligence (MATI) team
Impacted Systems: Machines in embassies (example: embassy in Brazil)
Organizations in Pakistan, Turkey, Russia, Saudi Arabia, Afghanistan, Jordan, Europe, North America
Oil and gas production companies (including one Russian company active in Middle East)
Indicators of Compromise: GitHub repository containing scripts matching Seedworm operations
PowerShell script matching victim machine compromised by Seedworm
Commands for Crackmapexec post-exploitation tool matching victim host activity
Attack Vector: Use of GitHub public repository to store malware and tools
Use of social networking services (Twitter) to observe infosec developments
Exploitation of Active Directory networks using Crackmapexec tool
